name: Chroma
one_liner: Programmable protein diffusion model steered by exact geometric, symmetry, and energy-potential conditioners and wet-lab validation.

loop.proposes: A polymer-physics-informed graph diffusion model samples 3D protein backbones and all-atom sequences in O(N) time.
loop.judged_by: Analytic point-group symmetry projectors, distance restraints, AlphaFold refolding consistency, and X-ray crystallography judge candidate proteins.
loop.steers: Bayes-rule score conditioning steers reverse-diffusion trajectories directly toward the specified symmetry or substructure constraints.

headline_result: Designed 310 proteins across point-group symmetries, programmable shapes, and protein classes, with crystallographic structures matching design to 1.0-1.4 Angstrom backbone RMSD.
caveat: Conditioning on extreme geometric shapes can reduce natural sequence designability if the score guidance weight is set too high.
beyond_harness_note: Analytic symmetry constraints and structural refolding oracles steer a non-LLM 3D protein diffusion process.
algorithmic_authority: Geometric symmetry projectors, refolding filters, and X-ray crystallography

sources.title: Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model (Nature, 2023)

verification.notes: Checked against Ingraham et al., Nature 623, 2023.
